sections.h2: Quick ways for a Balch Springs owner to sell
sections.html:
You can sell a Balch Springs house three ways: list it, handle the sale yourself, or accept cash from an investor who buys it as it stands and closes on your date. What works best depends on the condition of the house, any liens or city notices on it, and how soon you need the funds.

This is mostly an owner city, with 64.7 percent of homes occupied by their owners and 3.29 people in the average household. Sales often involve family homes kept for decades, houses that came through an estate, or rentals whose landlords want out. Most of the housing stock went up in the postwar decades as Dallas commuters moved in, so repairs tied to age are common.

  • Market listing: a good match when the house shows well and the buyer's lender signs off.
  • Investor purchase: skips showings and loan approval, and normally the repair list as well.
  • Payoffs first: mortgage, tax and code-fine balances all come out of the proceeds. Get each figure in writing before you agree to anything.

In the 2020-2024 estimates the typical owned home was worth $224,400 and the typical renter paid $1,378 monthly. Population is estimated at 27,258 for mid-2025: 1.6 percent less than the April 2020 baseline of 27,705, yet far above the 23,728 counted in 2010.

sections.h2: Rental registration and certificate of occupancy
sections.html:
Both are required. Landlords selling, and investors buying, will meet each one.

  • Rental registration: bring a driver's license and proof of ownership, for example closing paperwork or a deed in your name. Renew the registration every two years.
  • Inspection timing: a rental inspection has to happen before a tenant moves in, or the owner owes a violation fee.
  • Certificate of occupancy: bring a driver's license, a lease or proof of ownership, a site map and a floor plan.

Because registration follows the owner's name and deed, an investor who keeps the tenant files a new one after the deed is recorded. To learn what is on file for your address, call Permits and Inspections at 972-286-4477. Inspection requests go by email to inspections@balchspringstx.gov, and the city's permits page has the forms.

sections.h2: Permits and sign-offs when a house changes hands
sections.html:
A seller or investor buyer may need several permits. Electrical, plumbing and air conditioning work each require a separate permit, and a registered master contractor must pull it. A roof job with no structural work can get a same-day permit. The codes in force are the 2021 IRC and IBC and the 2020 NEC.

Running an estate or moving sale at the house? Garage sales are limited to three a calendar year, with 90 days between them. Any contractor you hire for pre-sale repairs must be registered with the city, so check the list first. Permits and Inspections can be reached at 972-286-4477.

sections.h2: Can an open city notice get in the way of a sale?
sections.html:
An open notice will not stop a sale. It does stay with the property, so either clear it or talk it through with the buyer before closing. Code officers drive the neighborhoods every day and answer complaints as well.

Your first letter sets a 10-day deadline to fix the problem, or 7 days for tall grass and solid waste, and stays on record for 12 months. When a second visit shows no change, the officer issues a Notice to Appear naming the ordinance, the fine and the court contact. An owner can request extra time to finish a repair.

Prior to listing, walk your lot with the city's Top 10 violations list, available in English and Spanish on the Code Enforcement page. Disclose any citation or court date to the buyer so nothing delays closing.

sections.h2: Time left before a foreclosure auction
sections.html:
Most Texas deeds of trust let a lender auction the home without a court case. The steps follow a fixed calendar, so a sale ahead of it is often realistic. Under federal servicing rules a first filing normally waits until the loan is over 120 days delinquent.

  • Once the default notice arrives you get 20 days to reinstate by paying the past-due amount.
  • Next the servicer must send notice of sale 21 or more days ahead, then post it at the courthouse and file it with the county clerk.
  • Bidding happens on the first Tuesday of the month, from 10 a.m. until 4 p.m.
  • A shortfall after the sale gives the lender two years to sue, and the borrower can request credit for the home's fair market value.

The Dallas County commissioners court picks the auction site, and the county clerk can tell you where. A sale that closes before that Tuesday pays off the loan with the proceeds. The State Law Library's foreclosure guide covers every stage.

sections.h2: How a tenant changes the sale
sections.html:
Every buyer should see the lease, because it controls what a new owner may do about the occupant. If the tenant must be gone by closing, a written notice to vacate normally allows three days at minimum, unless the lease sets another period.

If the tenant will not leave, the matter goes to justice court. Service must come four days or more before trial, and the hearing is set 10 to 21 days after filing. Either side may appeal to county court within five days of a loss. A writ of possession cannot issue until six days after final judgment. Many owners avoid the whole process by choosing a buyer who will keep the tenant.

sections.h2: Filing the deed and finishing the sale
sections.html: The Dallas County clerk records deeds for the city, which lies in Dallas County. Your signature has to be acknowledged before a notary or other authorized officer. After funding, the title company records the deed and pays each lien from your proceeds. Keep the settlement statement and payoff receipts.

faqs.q: Must I keep my rental registered until the Balch Springs sale closes?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as the house is rented. A registration runs two years and needs an inspection before any tenant moves in. If the buyer keeps renting, they register under their own name with proof of ownership.

faqs.q: How soon must a Balch Springs code notice be fixed?
faqs.a: Within ten days for most notices, seven for tall grass or solid waste. A second inspection that still finds the problem leads to a citation with a fine and a court date, though you may ask for more time.

faqs.q: Where is the deed filed for a Balch Springs sale?
faqs.a: At the Dallas County clerk's office, because the city is in Dallas County. Sign the deed and have it acknowledged by a notary or other authorized officer.

faqs.q: Is it too late to sell once the lender posts a foreclosure notice?
faqs.a: No, provided the sale closes first. You have 20 days after the default notice to reinstate, and the lender owes 21 or more days' notice of sale. Count backward from the first Tuesday of the month.

faqs.q: How many people live in Balch Springs?
faqs.a: About 27,258 in July 2025, living in 8,247 households counted for 2020-2024. That sits 1.6 percent under the April 2020 baseline, on 9.02 square miles.
